thag14.2:1.1: Yathāpi bhaddo ājañño dhure yutto dhurassaho mathito atibhārena saṃyugaṃ nātivattati, || ||
thag14.2:2.1: evaṃ paññāya ye tittā samuddo vārinā yathā na pare atimaññanti; ariyadhammo 'va pāṇinaṃ. || ||
thag14.2:3.1: kāle kālavasam pattā bhavābhavavasaṃ gatā narā dukkhaṃ nigacchanti, te 'dha socanti māṇavā. || ||
thag14.2:4.1: unnatā sukhadhammena dukkhadhammena vonatā dvayena bālā haññanti yathābhūtaṃ adassino. || ||
thag14.2:5.1: ye ca dukkhe sukhasmiñ ca majjhe sibbanim ajjhagū, ṭhitā te indakhīlo va, na te unnataonatā. || ||
thag14.2:6.1: na h' eva lābhe nālābhe na yase na ca kittiyā na nindāyaṃ pasaṃsāya na te dukkhe sukhamhi ca || ||
thag14.2:7.1: sabbattha te na lippanti udabindu va pokkhare, sabbattha sukhitā vīrā sabbattha aparājitā. || ||
thag14.2:8.1: dhammena ca alābho yo yo ca lābho adhammiko: alābho dhammiko seyyo yañ ce lābho adhammiko: || ||
thag14.2:9.1: yaso ca appabuddhīnaṃ viññūnaṃ ayaso ca yo: ayaso ca seyyo viññūnaṃ na yaso appabuddhinaṃ. || ||
thag14.2:10.1: dummedhehi pasaṃsā ca viññūhi garahā ca yā: garahā 'va seyyo viññūhi yañ ce bālappasaṃsanā. || ||
thag14.2:11.1: sukhañ ca kāmamayikaṃ dukkhañ ca pavivekiyaṃ: pavivekiyaṃ dukkhaṃ seyyo yañ ce kāmamayaṃ sukhaṃ. || ||
thag14.2:12.1: jīvitañ ca adhammena dhammena maraṇañ ca yaṃ: maraṇaṃ dhammikaṃ seyyo yañ ce jīve adhammikaṃ. || ||
thag14.2:13.1: kāmakopapahīnā ye santacittā bhavābhave caranti loke asitā, n' atthi tesaṃ piyāppiyaṃ. || ||
thag14.2:14.1: bhāvayitvāna bojjhaṅge indriyāni balāni ca pappuyya paramaṃ santiṃ parinibbanti anāsavā 'ti. || || Godatto thero. uddānaṃ: Revato c' eva Godatto
thag14.2:15.0: therā dve te mahiddhikā Cuddasamhi nipātamhi, gāthāyo aṭṭhavīsatīti.
